root_cause: This is a pure PPA area-gate failure, not a functional bug: the teacher TB is clean (trace_mismatches empty, failing_suites empty, return_code 0), but synthesized area is 215237 vs the 190000-library-unit budget. Two prior equivalence-preserving area rounds already edited dcache/icache/issue_queue/load_store_unit/reorder_buffer/rename_unit/branch_predictor without moving the gate, so the dominant area sinks are most likely in the modules not yet audited: the top-level rv32i5.sv (largest file at ~30KB, holding integration muxing, wide debug/retire-trace state and any shadow/duplicated arrays), the 64x32 physical register file (largest flop array), and the id_stage decode/control cone; execute_alu, if_stage and commit_unit are secondary contributors. The repair should be an equivalence-preserving area reduction concentrated there (remove unconsumed wide fields, share decode/mux terms, reduce PRF/checkpoint-style redundancy and any shadow state in the top level), leaving all TB-visible behavior untouched.
repair_constraints: Do not rename or remove any port, module, or file; the interface contract for rv32i5, icache, dcache, branch_predictor, if_stage, id_stage, rename_unit, physical_register_file, issue_queue, execute_alu, load_store_unit, reorder_buffer and commit_unit stays byte-for-byte identical.
The change must be equivalence-preserving: the teacher TB must remain fully PASS (no trace_mismatches, no failing_suites) while area drops below 190000 library units.

Preserve debug-event semantics exactly: one single-cycle dbg_retire_valid per committed instruction (load/store/branch/NOP/rd=x0/ECALL), correct dbg_bp_resolve/dbg_bp_mispredict timing, dbg_ooo_issue/dbg_ooo_bypass from real state, and halted=1 with exit_code=x10 on the cycle after ECALL commit (never halted=0 with exit_code!=0).

Preserve external handshake behavior: at most one in-flight imem/dmem request, valid/addr held until ready, no aborting of in-flight cache transactions, and the if_stage IF-response epoch guard (drop stale-epoch responses and re-fetch) must remain intact.

Keep the RTL synthesizable: no variable-row-index writes into unpacked 2D arrays (use constant-index row decode), no undriven internal nets, and no multiple nonblocking assignments to the same vector in one always block.
Trim only genuinely unconsumed wide fields/state; anything a TB check or internal consumer uses must keep identical value and timing.
Do not re-patch the already-edited cache/IQ/LSU/ROB/rename/BP files on speculation; if they must be re-evaluated, first restore the verified baseline and re-run the TB before changing them again.
